title: Direct deduplication key

mode.description: Broadcast keys on (mode, source_peer, channel, message_id) instead — and the GossipSub mesh duplicate key is a different thing again, being publisher plus wire sequence number (ADR-0004).

source_endpoint.description: Peer-asserted metadata: it proves only that the authenticated PeerId claimed this label. That is sufficient here, because the key's job is separating that peer's own streams, not authorizing anything.
